source: The simulated guild's officers: their overrides of the item-fit heuristic (ItemSuits events), for the raid items whose effect is not a stat, so the heuristic can't judge them (damage shields, absorbs, threat reduction, summons, armor penetration). The simulator writes them into its ledger before a raid night, through the same path a real officer's 'suits' command uses. Roles: tank, melee, hunter, caster, healer.

18815: Essence of the Pure Flame: a fire damage shield, for whoever is being hit
17082: Shard of the Flame: health regeneration and a stamina use effect, for tanks
21625: Scarab Brooch: heals leave an absorb shield
21647: Fetish of the Sand Reaver: threat reduction for physical damage
23558: The Burrower's Shell: an absorb, for tanks
21579: Vanquished Tentacle of C'Thun: a summoned tentacle that adds physical damage
21670: Badge of the Swarmguard: armor penetration on hit
